scope: This Codespace's local Observatory S3 deployment only

provenance.scope: Pinned native binary and embedded dependency/browser closure; no container image or newly installed build toolchain

review.upstream_minio_findings: Nine advisory IDs reconciled to verified ancestor fix commits of the exact source commit; raw matches and ancestry evidence preserved
review.console_production_closure: 315 resolved packages; three build-lock findings are outside that production closure; no npm/build packages installed or executed

remaining_known_finding.class: Denial of service through normalization looping on invalid input
remaining_known_finding.basis: Normalization routines are retained in the binary and the reviewed Go vendor implementation lacks upstream CL 794100

explicit_user_exception.authority: User replied yes after the specific SILO GO-2026-5970 exception and local S3 migration were disclosed
explicit_user_exception.scope: Exact pinned binary, loopback-only S3, independent random credentials, private persistent raw volume

operation.region_note: Compatibility configuration value; the server is SILO
operation.original_raw_bytes: S3 only; PostgreSQL stores references and SHA-256 metadata, ClickHouse stores parsed events
operation.retention: Content-addressed chunks and manifests; conditional creation, exact read-back, no expiration
operation.server_compression: Enabled; original uncompressed bytes returned and SHA-256 checked
operation.volume: Private persistent sparse 2 GiB filesystem; shares host physical capacity, no multi-node durability claim

limitations: The disclosed vulnerability remains; loopback and provenance are not asserted to fix it.
Checks exercise this actual single-node server and corpus, not every S3 API or crash-durability scenario.
Runtime binaries and package caches use temporary storage; original histories, databases, raw volume and credentials remain on persistent workspace storage.
Failed capacity-limited archival attempts and transient HTTP timeout measurements are preserved separately.
